visual_logic.composition: A coastal cliff scene. The slate-grey rocks are criss-crossed with a network of Paleopus vines. The plant is the only splash of bright green against the grey and buff earth.
visual_logic.background: The crashing waves of the Pacific lagoon and a pale, salt-hazy sky.
visual_logic.lighting: High-contrast, bright sunlight emphasizing the plant's struggle to cling to the stone.
